subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We wanted to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming flight reservation to Paris. Your departure time has been adjusted to 7:30 AM instead of the original 9:00 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us. Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
